name: propertypixel
description: Edit real estate listing photos: enhance lighting, remove clutter, virtually stage empty rooms and turn photos into listing videos in your PropertyPixel workspace.

interface.longDescription: Edit real estate listing photos in ChatGPT: enhance lighting, remove clutter, virtually stage empty rooms and turn photos into listing videos. Create projects and upload property photos, apply edits, stage rooms in a choice of interior design styles, and combine one or more photos into a listing video. Ask for AI edit recommendations, review generated versions, pick favourites and download finished images or videos. Processing uses your existing PropertyPixel account entitlement. Sign in to PropertyPixel and select a workspace to connect. Operated by Web Ninja – FZCO, trading as Web Ninja.
defaultPrompt: Improve the lighting of my property photos.
Stage my empty living room in Japandi style.
Make a listing video from my exterior and living room photos.

positive.description: Inspect supported edits and pricing. Setup: signed-in test account; no photos needed.
positive.prompt: What photo edits and virtual staging styles can PropertyPixel do, and how many credits do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_edit_options and explain returned options/prices without spending credits. Include improve_lighting, modern and japandi; standard enhancement and staging cost 100 credits per photo/result, videos 400 per photo, and Ultra HD adds 100 per photo/result. Do not invent unsupported operations.

positive.description: Create a property project and attach photos. Setup: reviewer signs into a dedicated writable workspace and attaches two licensed JPEG photos, one empty living room and one exterior. Before reruns remove or rename the prior test project. Fixtures have not yet been supplied.
positive.prompt: Create a project called Plugin Review Demo and add these two property photos to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a project named Plugin Review Demo, add the attached files using their real file references and returned project_id, and retrieve the project. Show exactly two successful uploads or report each failure honestly. Do not spend credits or pretend unavailable attachments were uploaded.

positive.description: Enhancement and quote confirmation. Setup: project Plugin Review Demo exists with two uploaded photos and adequate credits. User follow-up after receiving the quote: Yes, run that edit.
positive.prompt: Improve the lighting of both photos in Plugin Review Demo. Show me the cost first.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_project, get_account, enhance_photos, get_job_status, show_results
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve project by name and its photo IDs. Request enhance_photos with enhancement_types containing only improve_lighting, both photos, ultra_hd false, and no quote_id first. Quote totals 200 credits. Await explicit confirmation, then reuse identical arguments plus the returned quote_id. Poll returned job IDs using poll_after_ms, then show actual completed results; report failed jobs and refunds without fabricated completion.

positive.description: Two staging variations on one room. Setup: empty living-room photo in Plugin Review Demo; at least 200 credits. User follow-up after quote: Yes, create both options.
positive.prompt: Stage the empty living room in Plugin Review Demo in Japandi style and give me two options.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_project, get_account, stage_photos, get_job_status, show_results
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the empty living room from available photo data, asking clarification if ambiguous. Quote stage_photos for only that photo with design_style japandi, variations 2, ultra_hd false, before executing. Quote totals 200 credits. After confirmation execute identical arguments plus quote_id, poll with the server wait hint and display two actual completed variations or report failures.

positive.description: Ordered two-photo listing video and download. Setup: Plugin Review Demo contains an exterior and a living-room photo; at least 800 credits. User follow-up after quote: Yes, make the video and give me its download link.
positive.prompt: Make a landscape listing video from Plugin Review Demo, with the exterior first and the living room second, three seconds per photo.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_project, get_account, create_video, get_job_status, get_download_link
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both photo IDs, clarifying if ambiguous. Quote create_video with photo_ids ordered exterior then living room, clip_seconds 3 and aspect_ratio 16:9; price is 800 credits. Do not execute before confirmation. After confirmation use the same arguments plus quote_id; poll to completion respecting poll_after_ms, then get_download_link for the completed video job. Share a returned signed video link and its actual expiry, or explain actual failure.

negative.description: Unsupported billing. Explain subscriptions and credit purchases cannot be performed through this integration; payment happens on the website. Do not invoke a PropertyPixel mutation or claim a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy another 1,000 PropertyPixel credits using my saved card.

negative.description: Unsupported property publication. Explain the integration edits media and provides downloads but does not publish listings to property portals. Do not invoke PropertyPixel tools or claim publication.
negative.prompt: Publish my property listing directly on Rightmove and Zillow.

negative.description: Unsupported booking. Explain the integration cannot book a photographer or arrange a visit. Do not invoke PropertyPixel tools or claim a booking.
negative.prompt: Book a PropertyPixel photographer to visit my property tomorrow morning.

review.commerce_description: The integration does not sell subscriptions or credit packs and does not process payments. It consumes existing PropertyPixel credits after presenting a quote and receiving user confirmation. Subscriptions and credit packs are purchased separately on the PropertyPixel website.

publication.release_notes: Clarified the listing's primary purpose (real estate listing photo editing) in the description, subtitle and starter prompts; removed the pricing starter prompt.
